completeness.why: applyWeekendRule decides both whether the rule applies (skipWeekend) and the mode for all four sites; the only local decision left is getNextDate's noSkipWeekend option, which exists at that site alone and may stay there, and the field-name difference is removed by storing weekendSolveMode in the parsed schedule data.

interface.why: One small function taking the day and a {skipWeekend, weekendSolveMode} rule with no speculative options; instead of each caller mapping its own field name, it renames the parsed schedule's data field (only one reader), and it forces a day-string round trip at the upcoming-dates site.
